mentions.name: WarpGate
mentions.description: A gateway for MCP servers that centralizes authentication, auditing, and tool control, can auto-generate MCPs from OpenAPI specs, and supports accessing private MCP servers.
mentions.problem: Streamlining the pain points experienced with working with MCP, such as fragmented authentication, auditing, and tool control.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://usewarpgate.com: a MCP for MCPs, basically. Aiming to streamline all the pain points that I experienced with MCP in there. Centralised authentication, auditing, tool control, automatic MCPs through OpenAPI specs, accessing private servers, etc.
